classification: implementation correction discovered by unseen validation
diagnosis: The Responses adapter correctly constructed trajectory search context and an adopted bridge for a naturally produced Bash search output, but ContentRouter lost trajectory_search_relevance when the top-level strategy entered the MIXED routing path. Consequently search-like subsections did not receive the trajectory override and adopted preservation could not reach relevance_split.

correction.description: Propagate trajectory_search_relevance through _compress_mixed and into section-level _apply_strategy_to_content calls.
correction.focused_test_command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_trajectory_relevance.py tests/test_adopted_bridge_preservation.py tests/test_transforms_content_router.py

interpretation: U01 is not counted as unseen validation of the corrected implementation.
The U01 result is retained as evidence of a real production integration failure discovered by the unseen experiment.
No U01 retention outcome will be used as prospective evidence for the corrected implementation.

post_fix_validation.selection_rule: first remaining candidate satisfying frozen corrected-production applicability conditions
